separate_dimensions.presence: physical persistent people/assets at a location
separate_dimensions.claim: asserted entitlement over a defined scope
separate_dimensions.effective_control: ability to administer/enforce policy in practice
separate_dimensions.sovereignty: political status of ultimate governing authority
separate_dimensions.recognition: what other parties accept or acknowledge

rules: Presence does not automatically equal sovereignty.
A declared claim does not automatically equal effective control.
Effective control may exist without universal external recognition.
Claim scope must reference real locations/geometry and effective time.
A colony cannot claim arbitrary surrounding systems merely by existing.
Historical claims may survive abandonment while effective control ends.
Occupation or war-derived control is outside Block 2 and must come from later validated events.
